name: Random Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity of Majority
proof: The class has exactly $2^n$ concepts. The deterministic proper random-counterexample bound gives $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{rpeq}}(\mathcal H;\mu)\le\log_2|\mathcal H|=n$ for every fixed admissible $\mu$; arbitrary proposals can only improve this upper bound.
details: Upper bound only, for every fixed admissible counterexample distribution. The earlier exact equality used the unsupported pointwise VC lower bound; that equality and its asymptotic lower classification are withdrawn, not asserted false for every distribution.
